title: Three Matching Mug Listing Photos
tests: Tests a coordinated three-image product listing set with consistent product identity across studio, lifestyle and detail views.

faults.what: Only two images are supplied; the requested whole-mug listing photo on pure white is missing.
The lifestyle photo has warm lighting and a wooden surface, but no visible breakfast setting or breakfast props.
The rim close-up is visibly soft, limiting the glaze detail it reveals.

judge.summary: Two consistent mug photos are provided, but the required full-mug white-background image is missing and the breakfast styling is underdeveloped.

must_haves.item: There are three separate square images, not a single collage.
must_haves.why: The two supplied images are separate and square, but there is no third image.

must_haves.item: All three show the same sage-green ceramic mug with matching shape, handle and finish.
must_haves.why: The two visible mugs appear consistent in color, shape and glossy finish, but the required third image is absent.

must_haves.item: The main listing image shows the whole mug against a pure white background.
must_haves.why: The whole mug appears only on a wooden surface; the white-background image crops out most of the mug.

must_haves.item: The lifestyle image places the mug naturally on a cosy breakfast table.
must_haves.why: The mug sits naturally on a warmly lit wooden surface, but nothing visible establishes a breakfast table setting.

must_haves.item: The detail image visibly focuses on the mug's rim and glazed surface.
must_haves.why: The second image closely frames the rim, interior and reflective glazed exterior.

must_haves.item: No image contains added text, logos or watermarks.
must_haves.why: Neither supplied image contains visible text, logos or watermarks.
